# White Frog Productions

> Contemporary luxury wedding filmmaking and fine-art photography studio helmed by Kunal Khanna & Madhavi Singh. Specializing in unscripted, emotive documentary heirlooms for destination celebrations worldwide.

## Overview
- **Studio**: White Frog Productions
- **Founders & Creative Directors**: Kunal Khanna & Madhavi Singh
- **Established**: September 2012 (12+ years of luxury industry leadership)
- **Headquarters**: New Delhi / Delhi NCR, India
- **Global Coverage**: Delhi NCR, Rajasthan (Udaipur, Jaipur, Jodhpur, Jaisalmer), Goa, Jim Corbett, Mussoorie, Kashmir, Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Italy (Lake Como, Tuscany, Amalfi Coast), Thailand (Hua Hin, Phuket, Koh Samui), Bali, UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), and Worldwide.
- **Track Record**: Over 500+ luxury destination weddings documented across India, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
- **Accolades & Press**: Featured in leading international wedding publications, Vogue, Harper's Bazaar Bride, WedMeGood, WeddingSutra, and Wedwise.
- **Official Website**: https://www.whitefrogproductions.com
- **Direct Email**: kunal@whitefrogproductions.com
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 98711 11762

## Artistic Philosophy & Technical Standards
- **Emotion Over Staged Performance**: We reject artificial directing, forced poses, and interrupting the sacred flow of weddings. 85% of coverage is pure photojournalistic documentary.
- **Integrated Crew Harmony**: One unified cinematography and fine-art photography team sharing identical color grading, lighting philosophy, and non-intrusive etiquette.
- **Bespoke Color Science**: Every film is color-graded shot-by-shot in DaVinci Resolve using proprietary 35mm film emulation curves (Kodak 2383 / Vision3) calibrated to preserve authentic Indian bridal skin tones and royal silk textiles.
- **32-Bit Float Audio Engineering**: Vows, family speeches, and ambient musical instruments are recorded using 32-bit float technology and professional wireless lavaliers, preventing clipping or audio distortion.
- **Dual Camera Redundancy**: All camera bodies record simultaneously to dual internal memory cards, backed up on encrypted solid-state drives and secure cloud storage daily on location.

## Key Offerings & Deliverables
- **Feature Films**: 25–45 minute long-form narrative documentaries capturing the full emotional depth of multi-day celebrations.
- **Cinematic Trailers**: 3–5 minute heirloom highlights crafted with cinematic pacing, original speech sound bites, and licensed acoustic scoring.
- **One-Minute Social Teasers**: High-impact editorial reels delivered within days of the celebration.
- **Fine-Art Photography**: Curated gallery collections of 1,000+ high-resolution, magazine-editorial digital stills and handcrafted leather-bound flush-mount albums.
- **Pre-Wedding Cinema**: Narrative couple films shot in dramatic international landscapes, heritage forts, or intimate private estates.

## Primary Destinations & Heritage Venues
- **Udaipur**: The Oberoi Udaivilas, Taj Lake Palace, The Leela Palace Udaipur, Jagmandir Island Palace, Raffles Udaipur, Fateh Prakash Palace.
- **Jaipur**: Rambagh Palace, Jai Mahal Palace, Fairmont Jaipur, Samode Palace, Samode Bagh, The Oberoi Rajvilas, Alila Fort Bishangarh.
- **Jodhpur**: Umaid Bhawan Palace, Indana Palace Jodhpur, Welcomhotel Jodhpur, Ajit Bhawan, RAAS Jodhpur.
- **Jaisalmer**: Suryagarh Jaisalmer, Jaisalmer Marriott Resort & Spa, Fort Rajwada.
- **Delhi NCR**: ITC Grand Bharat, The Leela Palace Chanakyapuri, Taj Palace, The Imperial, Andaz Delhi Aerocity, Tijara Fort Palace, Neemrana Fort Palace, Noor Mahal Karnal.
- **Goa**: Taj Exotica Resort Benaulim, The St. Regis Goa, W Goa Vagator, Grand Hyatt Bambolim, Alila Diwa Majorda, ITC Grand Goa.
- **Himalayas & Uttarakhand**: The Solluna Resort Jim Corbett, Taj Corbett, JW Marriott Mussoorie Walnut Grove, Taj Rishikesh, Ananda in the Himalayas.
- **International**: Dusit Thani Hua Hin (Thailand), Rayong Marriott (Thailand), Banyan Tree Phuket (Thailand), The Mulia & Bulgari Resort (Bali), Villa Balbianello & Villa d'Este (Lake Como, Italy), Emirates Palace (Abu Dhabi), Atlantis The Royal (Dubai).
